(17 October) |lowest attendance= |attendance=1,344,615 |average attendance=6,967 |prevseason=[[2018 Chilean Primera División|2018]] |nextseason=[[2020 Chilean Primera División|2020]] }} The '''2019 [[Chilean Primera División|Campeonato Nacional]]''', known as '''Campeonato AFP PlanVital 2019''' for sponsorship reasons,{{cite web|url=http://www.anfp.cl/noticia/32549/afp-planvital-el-nuevo-socio-comercial-de-la-primera-division-del-futbol-chileno|title=AFP PlanVital, el nuevo socio comercial de la Primera División del fútbol chileno|language=es|publisher=ANFP|date=15 February 2019|access-date=17 February 2019|archive-date=12 August 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230812192708/https://www.anfp.cl/noticia/32549/afp-planvital-el-nuevo-socio-comercial-de-la-primera-division-del-futbol-chileno|url-status=dead}} was the 89th season of top-flight football in [[Chile]]. The season started on 15 February 2019.{{cite web |url=https://www.24horas.cl/deportes/futbol-nacional/la-fecha-en-que-comenzara-el-campeonato-nacional-2019-de-primera-division-del-futbol-chileno-2904678|title=La fecha en que comenzará el Campeonato Nacional 2019 del fútbol chileno|language=es|publisher=24horas.cl|date=30 November 2018|access-date=24 December 2018}} [[Club Deportivo Universidad Católica|Universidad Católica]] were the defending champions, having won the [[2018 Chilean Primera División|previous tournament]]. Due to the [[2019 Chilean protests]], the competition was suspended since mid-October with six matchdays still left. After a failed attempt to resume normal activity that saw only one match fully played,{{cite web |url=https://www.t13.cl/noticia/deportes13/futbol-chileno-anfp-suspende-fecha-22-11-2019|title=LA ANFP SUSPENDE NUEVAMENTE LA FECHA DEL FÚTBOL CHILENO POR "FALTA DE CONTINGENTES POLICIALES"|language=es|publisher=t13.cl|date=22 November 2019}} on 29 November 2019, [[Asociación Nacional de Fútbol Profesional|ANFP]]'s Council of Presidents voted to conclude the season. Thus Universidad Católica, who were leading the competition at the time of the suspension, won their fourteenth title.{{cite web |url=https://www.latercera.com/el-deportivo/noticia/se-acaba-torneo-nacional/919969/|title=La ANFP da por concluido el torneo: la UC es el campeón|language=es|publisher=La Tercera|date=29 November 2019}}{{Cite web|url=https://chiletoday.cl/site/universidad-catolica-champion-of-chile-as-season-stops-short/|title=Universidad Católica Champion of Chile As Season Stops Short|website=Chile Today|date=1 December 2019|access-date=3 December 2019}} No teams were relegated to the [[Primera B de Chile|Primera B]] this season. ==Teams== Sixteen teams took part in the league in this season: the top fourteen teams from the previous season, plus [[Coquimbo Unido]] and [[C.D. Cobresal|Cobresal]], who were promoted from the [[Primera B de Chile|Primera B]].
